messages:
sam_cs: Flagging Solara Dynamics renewal — 16 days out. Procurement wants to keep current list but is open to a 12‑month commitment if we include Dedicated capacity (reserved GPUs) at a 7% discount. They're asking if pricing/term can be combined into a single amendment and if reseller invoicing via their partner (AcmeProcure) is acceptable.
leo_ae: Interesting — dedicated commitment could upsell. Can Finance/RevOps approve 7% off in exchange for 12m Dedicated? Also need to confirm reseller PO flow: will AcmeProcure issue PO to Redwood or to Solara with us as a line item?
paul_billing: Reseller flow matters for tax. If AcmeProcure issues the PO to us directly we invoice Redwood Inc. as usual. If Solara is invoiced and then pays AcmeProcure, we need their reseller agreement and a remittance schedule. Also flag: Brazil withholdings — Solara's Brazilian subsidiary may require withholding tax on software invoices. Need WHT documentation or gross-up in the SOW.
tara_legal: If we're adding Dedicated SLA and a reseller payment flow, Legal needs: (1) short SLA addendum for Dedicated latency/uptime, (2) a reseller invoicing clause, and (3) explicit tax treatment clause (who bears WHT). I can draft a 1-page amendment. Any SSO/KMS asks?
sam_cs: No KMS. They did ask that Dedicated be available in us-east region and that onboarding credits (4 hrs eng time) be included. Also procurement noted AcmeProcure sometimes requires a wet-sign for vendor onboarding in LATAM — could complicate DocuSign.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: env-SOL-4432 (status: draft). Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-SOL-4432
maria_finance: RevOps note: finance can approve 7% discount for a 12-month reserved commit if commercial attaches a signed amendment and either (a) PO from AcmeProcure naming Redwood as vendor, or (b) credit-approved Net60 from Solara's corporate. For Brazil WHT, we need their WHT certificate or we must gross-up. Net60 terms require credit approval and AP references; this will take ~3 business days.
leo_ae: So actionable items: Legal draft amendment (SLA + reseller + WHT), Billing confirm preferred invoicing path with procurement, CS get exec-level e-mail confirming dedicated commit, and AE secure PO or credit approval. I'll chase Solara procurement now.
paul_billing: Also request vendor code early. PO examples for our AP: ```
PO: ACME-SOL-2026-77
Vendor code: 88123-RW
Line: Dedicated 12m reserved capacity - Redwood Inference
Billing entity: Redwood Inc.
```
sam_cs: Noted — procurement said they can send PO but might require wet-sign on reseller form for LATAM. I'll ask if AcmeProcure can e-sign the PO and upload WHT certificate.
tara_legal: Drafting amendment now. I'll include fallback language: "If WHT applies and certificate not provided within 30 days, Company may gross-up fees or invoice additional tax amount." Will post draft link in ~6h.
maria_finance: If a wet-sign blocks things longer than 10 days we can allow an interim CC payment for first invoice cycle, but credit terms won't apply until we complete credit approval. Attach exec email to ticket for provisional terms.
sam_cs: Thanks — I'll gather exec confirmation, ask procurement for vendor code and WHT cert, and post updates. Will signal when DocuSign envelope is ready to send. :v:
